blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reconstructing cell lineages from 3D time-lapse microscopy requires distinguishing cell motion from division and inferring temporally consistent connections. When only a subset of cells is annotated, however, training procedures that treat unannotated regions as background or incorrect correspondences can be problematic. We propose a cell tracking pipeline that integrates detection from sparse annotations, calibration of candidate connections using image features, and joint selection of lineage graph events. For detection, we combine the outputs of 2.5D and 3D models trained to suppress erroneous background supervision at unannotated cells. We then calibrate ordinary link and division probabilities using motion features from dense flow, correspondence features from a learned cell-matching model, and features from models that identify cells immediately before division, dividing parents, and daughters immediately after division. Ordinary links, divisions represented as daughter pairs, and node inclusion are selected jointly under a surrogate objective derived from the evaluation metric, followed by gap filling and temporal coordinate refinement. The pipeline achieves an overall score of 0.9762 in 5-fold cross-validation on 199 videos from 2 zebrafish embryos. With candidates and calibrated values held fixed, joint selection outperforms a sequential method that allows replacement of existing divisions and reoptimization of ordinary links by 0.0105. The improvement arises primarily from division recovery.
blocks.zh: 从3D时间拉伸显微镜重构细胞线,需要区分细胞运动与分裂,并推断出时间上一致的连接. 然而,如果只附加一个单元,将未附加说明的区域当作背景或错误的函证处理的培训程序可能会有问题。 我们建议建立一个细胞跟踪管道,将从稀疏的注释中检测到,利用图像特性校准候选连接,以及联合选择线程图事件. 为了侦测,我们把2.5D和3D模型的输出结合起来,在无注释的细胞中,经过培训,以压制错误的背景监督. 然后,我们利用密集流中的运动特征, 学习细胞匹配模型中的对应特征, 以及模型中的特征来校准普通的连接和分裂概率。 这些特征在分裂之前就识别细胞, 分裂父母, 分裂之后就识别女儿。 普通的链接,代表为女对子的分割,节点的包含,都是在从评价衡量标准中衍生出来的代位目标下联合选择的,然后是补缺和时间协调的完善. 该管道在2个斑马鱼胚胎的199个视频上以5倍的交叉验证方式实现总得分0.9762分. 有了候选人和固定的校准值,联合选择的成绩就超过了一种顺序方法,从而可以于0.0105年替换现有的分部,并重新优化普通链接。 改善主要来自部门恢复。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Tracking cell motion and division during development is essential for understanding how biological tissues form. Light-sheet microscopy of zebrafish embryos has enabled large-scale reconstruction of nuclear positions, movements, and divisions throughout an embryo [ 6 ] . Nevertheless, identifying individual cells and manually recording temporal correspondences and parent–daughter relationships in large image collections requires substantial effort. Automated tracking also remains challenging in densely populated tissues, where cells have similar appearances and images contain noise and intensity variations. The Cell Tracking Challenge has advanced the comparison and generalization assessment of cell segmentation and tracking methods through diverse 2D and 3D time-lapse datasets and a common evaluation protocol [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 跟踪细胞在发育过程中的运动和分裂对于了解生物组织是如何形成的至关重要. 斑马鱼胚胎的光板显微镜使得整个胚胎的核位置、运动和分裂得以大规模重建[6]。 然而,需要付出很大努力,才能确定个人细胞,并在大型图像收藏中手动记录时间信函和亲女关系。 在人口稠密的组织中,自动跟踪也仍然具有挑战性,在这些组织中,细胞的外观和图像类似,含有噪音和强度变化。 细胞跟踪挑战通过不同的2D和3D时间间隔数据集以及共同评价协议[10],推进了细胞分化和跟踪方法的比较和概括评估.

blocks.en: Several approaches learn from limited annotations. 3D U-Net demonstrated volumetric segmentation trained from annotations on a subset of image slices [ 3 ] . For cell tracking, ELEPHANT combines a small number of nuclear annotations with interactive corrections to incrementally train 3D nuclear detection and optical-flow-based tracking. During detector training, background labels are supplied manually or through intensity thresholding in addition to nuclear annotations, and voxels with neither label are excluded from the supervised loss. Its supervision is progressively expanded through cycles of annotation, prediction, and correction [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 一些办法从有限的说明中吸取了教训。 3D U-Net从一个图像切片子上的注释中演示出批量分解。 对于细胞跟踪,ELEPHANT结合了少量的核说明和交互式校正,以渐进地训练出3D核探测和光相流跟踪. 在探测器训练期间,除了核说明外,还手动或通过强度阈值提供背景标签,没有标签的活塞被排除在监督损失之外。 它的监督通过注释、预测和纠正的周期逐步扩大[13]。

blocks.en: Temporal correspondence learning has also been addressed in different ways. EmbedTrack jointly performs segmentation and tracking in 2D images by learning offsets from each pixel to the corresponding cell centers in the current and preceding frames [ 8 ] . Trackastra uses a Transformer to model features such as cell positions and shapes within a temporal window and learns associations that include the one-to-many correspondences arising from division [ 4 ] . Building on the use of motion estimation and context among cells, we evaluate correspondences using motion-compensated spatial relationships and learned appearance features.
blocks.zh: 临时函授学习也以不同方式进行。 EmbedTrack通过学习从每个像素到当前和之前的相框中对应的单元格中心相抵消[8],在2D图像中共同进行分解和跟踪. Trackastra使用变形器在时间窗口内模拟细胞位置和形状等特征,并学习包括由分出[4]产生的一对多相通的关联. 在细胞间利用运动估计和上下文的基础上,我们利用运动补偿的空间关系和所学到的外观特征来评价函文.

blocks.en: Graph optimization has been used to enforce consistency among candidates during lineage reconstruction. Conservation Tracking handles divisions, oversegmentation, and undersegmentation through a probabilistic graphical model with constraints on the consistency of cell counts within detections [ 12 ] . Ultrack retains multiple segmentation hypotheses and selects candidates and connections according to temporal consistency, allowing segmentation ambiguity to be resolved during tracking [ 1 ] . We likewise combine image-derived scores with structural constraints, addressing competition between ordinary links and divisions in a graph whose nodes represent cell centers.
blocks.zh: 采用图表优化方法,在家族重建期间加强候选人的一致性。 保护跟踪通过概率图形模型处理分裂,过度分化,并进行下分化,在检测中限制细胞计数的一致性[12]. Ultrack保留了多个分块假说,并根据时间一致性选择候选人和连接,允许分块模糊问题在跟踪过程中被解决 [1]. 同样,我们把图像得分和结构限制结合起来,用一个代表细胞中心的图处理普通链接和分裂之间的竞争。

blocks.en: Linajea is closely related: it learns cell centers and movement from sparse point annotations and selects lineage graphs using integer linear programming [ 9 ] . Its detection loss is restricted to neighborhoods of annotated centers. Hirsch et al. extend this framework with parent, daughter, and continuation-state scores and consistency constraints [ 5 ] . These studies establish sparse supervision and division-aware global selection as existing approaches. Our design retains background supervision outside regions likely to contain unannotated cells and combines motion, matching, and division-stage features to calibrate daughter-pair events. We select these events together with supporting ordinary links using a metric-derived objective, and evaluate this combination through comparisons with shared candidates and calibrated values.
blocks.zh: Linajea是紧密相联的:它从稀有的点注释中学习到细胞中心和运动,并使用整数线性编程来选择线性图表[9]. 其检测损失仅限于有说明的中心的街区. Hirsch等 (英语). 将这个框架与父母、女儿和延续状态的分数和一致性限制相扩展[5]。 这些研究将零星的监督和了解各司情况的全球选择作为现有办法。 我们的设计保留了外部背景监督 可能包含无说明的细胞 并结合运动,匹配, 和分级特征 校正的女儿-pair事件。 我们选择这些活动,同时利用一种由衡量标准产生的目标支持普通联系,并通过与共同候选人和校准价值进行比较来评价这种结合。

blocks.en: The Biohub - Cell Tracking During Development competition was organized to develop cell tracking methods for this task. 1 1 1 Biohub – Cell Tracking During Development , Kaggle, 2026. The inputs are 3D time-lapse images of fluorescently labeled zebrafish embryos. The prediction targets are cell center positions at each time point and temporal connections describing cell continuation and division. Predictions are represented as a lineage graph with cell detections as nodes and temporal connections as directed edges. The task requires center detection and lineage reconstruction rather than cell segmentation.
blocks.zh: Biohub - Cell Tracking Industruction的比赛是为了制定这一任务的细胞跟踪方法而组织的. 1 1 Biohub – Cell Track Industruction, Kaggle, 2026. 输入是荧光标记为斑马鱼胚胎的3D相片. 预测目标是每个时间点的细胞中心位置和描述细胞延续和分裂的时间连接. 预测以分系图表示,以细胞检测为节点,以时间连接为定向边缘. 任务需要中心检测和家族重建,而不是细胞分化.

blocks.en: A central challenge in this dataset is that annotations cover only a subset of cells. Across 199 videos from 2 embryos, the pooled ratio of annotated nodes to the estimated total number of nodes is approximately 2.8%. This ratio concerns cell–time pairs and does not directly indicate the fraction of individual cells tracked within an embryo. Treating every unannotated location as background may suppress the detection of real cells. Moreover, there are only 151 annotated divisions, counted across all crops, requiring division morphology and parent–daughter relationships to be learned from few positive examples.
blocks.zh: 这个数据集的一个中心挑战是说明只涵盖一个子集的单元格. 在2个胚胎的199个视频中,附加说明的节点与估计的节点总数的比例约为2.8%。 这一比率涉及细胞-时间对子,并不直接表示胚胎内跟踪的单个细胞的分数. 将每个无附加说明的位置当作背景,可能会抑制对真细胞的检测. 此外,在所有作物中,只有151个附加说明的分块,需要从少数积极的例子中吸取分块形态和亲女关系。

blocks.en: Proximity-based association becomes ambiguous when cell motion, division, and temporary missed detections occur together. Even if a division-specific appearance is identified, the lineage cannot be reconstructed correctly when its daughters are assigned to other tracks. Local correspondence assessment using image features therefore needs to be integrated with structural constraints on parent–daughter relationships.
blocks.zh: 当细胞运动,分裂,以及暂时被忽略的检测同时发生时,基于亲和的关联变得模糊不清. 即使识别出一个分出特定的外观,当其女儿被分配到其他音轨时,血统也无法被正确重建. 因此,利用图像特性进行地方通信评估需要与父母-女儿关系的结构限制结合起来。

blocks.en: We propose a tracking method that integrates detection from sparse annotations, calibration of candidate connections using motion, appearance, and division features, and joint selection of lineage graph events. Because detection quality affects both downstream correspondence estimation and division recovery, we design detection and lineage selection as a unified pipeline. Our contributions are threefold.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一种跟踪方法,将从稀疏的注释中检测到的,利用运动,外观,和分位特征对候选连接进行校正,以及联合选择分行图事件. 由于检测质量既会影响下游的函证估计,也会影响分部恢复,因此我们设计检测和分行选择作为统一的管道. 我们的贡献有三个方面。

blocks.en: First, to improve detection under sparse annotation, we combine training that suppresses erroneous background supervision at unannotated cells with an ensemble of 2.5D and 3D models. Heatmaps from a 2.5D U-Net initialized with 2D pretrained weights and a SegResNet using 3D convolutions are combined to produce a common set of cell candidates for downstream tracking.
blocks.zh: 首先,为了在稀疏的注解下改进检测,我们把在无注解的细胞中压制错误背景监督的训练与2.5D和3D模型的组合结合起来. 由 2.5D U-Net 初始化并带有 2D 预训重量的热映射和 使用 3D 演化的 SegResNet 合并生成一套常见的细胞候选物,用于下游跟踪.

blocks.en: Second, we integrate dense-flow motion features, matcher correspondence features, and image features that identify stages before and after division to calibrate ordinary link and daughter-pair probabilities. Let t t denote the time of the dividing parent. We identify its predecessor at t − 1 t-1 , the parent at t t , and its daughters at t + 1 t+1 as pre, parent, and post, respectively. By estimating separately the probability that a candidate is evaluated and the probability that it is correct conditional on evaluation, we translate motion, appearance, and division-stage evidence into the expected contribution of a candidate connection.
blocks.zh: 其次,我们综合了密集相流运动特征,匹配相通特征,以及识别分相前后相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 t 表示分离父的时间 。 我们确定它的前身在 t − 1 t 1,父母在 t ,女儿在 t + 1 t + 1 ,分别是前,父母和后. 通过分别估计候选人得到评价的概率和以评价为条件的正确概率,我们将动议、外表和分阶段证据转化为候选人联系的预期贡献。

blocks.en: Third, we construct a surrogate objective from the edge term with its node-count adjustment and the division term, and jointly select ordinary links, divisions represented as daughter pairs, and node inclusion under connection-capacity and temporal-support constraints. A division and the preceding and following ordinary links needed to support it are selected together, ensuring consistency among competing connections.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们用它的节点计数调整和分词从边缘术语中构建一个代位目标,并共同选择普通的链接,以女儿配对为代表的分部,并在连接能力和时间支持限制下将节点包含在内. 共同选定一个司以及支持它所需的前后的普通链接,以确保相互竞争的连接的一致性。

blocks.en: We evaluate the complete pipeline and use ablations with shared detection candidates to assess calibration features, calibrators, information from before and after division, and the selection strategy. We also compare division input alignment with the number of inputs and model capacity held fixed, and evaluate transfer of the downstream models when the detector is replaced by a publicly available model.
blocks.zh: 我们评估整个管道,并使用与共同检测候选人的混合材料来评估校准特征、校准器、师前和师后的信息以及甄选战略。 我们还比较了部门投入与固定投入数量和模型容量的对接情况,并在探测器被公开的模型所取代时评价下游模型的转移情况.

blocks.en: 2 Proposed Approach
blocks.zh: 2 拟议办法

blocks.en: Let I t I_{t} denote the input image at time t t , and V t V_{t} the set of candidate cells. The proposed method detects V t V_{t} , assigns correspondence and division scores to candidates in adjacent frames, and determines connections under constraints on the entire graph. Unless otherwise specified, distances and displacements are expressed in physical coordinates in μ \mu m. We refer to annotated cell positions and connections as ground truth (GT).
blocks.zh: 让我表示时间t t 的输入图像, V t V_{t 表示一组候选单元格。 拟议的方法检测出V t V_{t},在相邻框架内为考生分配函证和分数,并在全图的限制下确定连接. 除非另有说明,相距和相去相去以μ\mu m表示。 我们把附加说明的牢房位置和联系称为地面真相。

blocks.en: The detector combines heatmaps from 2.5D and 3D models and outputs a position and confidence for each candidate. Dense flow estimates motion between adjacent frames, and cell matching computes correspondence scores from motion-compensated spatial relationships and image features. The same flow is also used to align the inputs of the division-parent model. Scores for pre, parent, and post, corresponding to cells immediately before division, dividing parents, and daughters immediately after division, are used together with motion and correspondence features to calibrate ordinary links and division candidates.
blocks.zh: 探测器结合了2.5D和3D模型的热图,为每个候选人输出一个位置和信心. Dense流量估计相邻帧之间的运动,与细胞相匹配计算出由运动补偿的空间关系和图像特征产生的对应分. 同样的流也用于对接分母模式的投入. 预分,父分和后分的分数,与分裂前的细胞相对应,分裂后的父母分出,和分裂后的女儿分出,同时使用运动和函授特征来校正普通的链接和分裂候选人.

blocks.en:
Lineage graph optimization integrates these scores and selects nodes, ordinary links, and divisions, followed by gap filling and coordinate refinement. Image models and calibrators are trained in stages, and their predictions are integrated through graph optimization. This design allows downstream components to be compared with detection candidates held fixed. We address offline tracking, where the entire video is available; division identification and coordinate refinement also use future frames.
Figure 1 summarizes the inference pipeline.

blocks.en: 2.1 Backbone Architecture for 3D Volumes
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维卷后骨结构

blocks.en: We primarily use a 2.5D U-Net to extract features from 3D images. This architecture integrates information along the depth axis while using an encoder pretrained on 2D images. The basic design follows 2.5D U-Net with Depth Reduction [ 16 ] by Uchida and Fukui.
blocks.zh: 我们主要使用2.5D U-Net从3D图像中提取特性. 这种架构在使用2D图像上预加的编码器的同时,会将信息沿深度轴进行整合. 基本设计遵循了由内田和福井作的2.5D U-Net并有深度还原[16].

blocks.en: At each encoder stage, z slices are folded into the batch dimension for 2D convolution. The stage output is restored to its 3D arrangement, reduced in depth by average pooling along z, and passed to the next stage. The decoder receives 3D features through skip connections and restores spatial resolution using upsampling and 3D convolutions. This architecture aggregates depth context hierarchically while retaining pretrained 2D encoder weights for initialization.
blocks.zh: 在每一个编码器阶段,z切片被折叠入分批维度以进行2D相变. 相位输出恢复到3D安排,由平均相位与z相接而来被深度降低,并被传递到下个相位. 解码器通过跳过连接接收出3D特性,并使用上采样和3D分解来恢复空间分辨率. 这种架构分级地聚合了深度上下文,同时保留了被预先训练的2D编码器重来初始化.

blocks.en: For the 2.5D detection and matching models, each input slice is stacked along the channel dimension with its neighboring z slices, yielding 3 channels for the 2D encoder. This exposes the earliest feature extraction stage to local depth information. These channels represent spatial neighbors and are distinct from the temporal inputs used in Section 2.5 . In the division models, a shared encoder processes each single-channel image separately before temporal information is integrated.
blocks.zh: 对于2.5D检测和匹配模型,每个输入切片会和相邻的z切片沿通道维相叠,为2D编码器产生3个通道. 这让最早的地物取出阶段暴露于本地深度信息. 这些频道代表了空间相邻,有别于第2.5节中使用的时间输入。 在分区模型中,一个共享编码器在时间信息整合之前分别处理每个单通道图像.

blocks.en: We use EfficientNetV2 [ 15 ] and EfficientNet [ 14 ] as 2D encoders. Detection uses EfficientNetV2-L and EfficientNet-B7, whereas matching and division identification use EfficientNetV2-S. The matching model outputs intermediate decoder features, and the detection models output single-channel heatmaps. The architecture is shared across tasks, but the weights are trained independently.
blocks.zh: 我们使用高效NetV2[15]和高效Net[14]作为2D编码器. 检测使用高效率的NetV2-L和高效率的Net-B7,而匹配和划分识别使用高效的NetV2-S. 匹配模型输出中间解码器功能,检测模型输出单通道热图. 建筑是跨任务共享的,但权重是独立训练的.

blocks.en: For detection, we also use the fully 3D SegResNet [ 11 ] implemented in MONAI [ 2 ] . It has a residual encoder–decoder built from 3D convolutions, 32 initial channels, 4 encoder stages with 1 residual block per stage, and Group Normalization. Its heatmap is included in the ensemble because its feature extraction differs from that of the 2.5D models. The flow model is a separate, compact 3D network described in Section 2.3 .

blocks.en: 2.3 Dense Flow Estimation
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 密集流量估计

blocks.en: Association based only on distance, without accounting for cell motion, can fail under collective movement and local deformation. We therefore estimate dense flow between adjacent 3D images and predict the location of each detected cell in the next frame.
blocks.zh: 仅基于距离的关联,不考虑细胞运动,在集体运动和局部变形下可能失败. 因此,我们估计相邻的三维图像之间的密集流量,并预测下一个框架中每个被检测到的细胞的位置.

blocks.en: Images are downsampled by factors of ( z , y , x ) = ( 1 , 4 , 4 ) (z,y,x)=(1,4,4) , yielding an isotropic grid with 1.625 μ \mu m spacing along each axis. A shared 3D encoder processes the two images, and local correlations are computed between features at half resolution. Correlations over candidate displacements are normalized with a softmax, and their expected displacement provides the initial flow. This flow is interpolated to the input resolution and refined by a residual predicted by a decoder that combines deeper features from both images.
blocks.zh: 图像由(z,y,x)=(1,4,4)=(z,y,x)=(1,4,4)的因子来下取样,产生一个相向网格,每个轴相距为1.625 μ \ mu m. 共享的 3D 编码器处理这两个图像,并在半解析度时计算特性之间的局部相关性。 与候选流离失所现象的关联性与温和关系正常化,他们预期的流离失所现象提供了初步流动。 这种流被内插到输入分辨率上,并被一个将两个图像的更深的特征结合在一起的解码器所预言的残余来完善.

blocks.en: The flow model has 3 encoder stages with 32, 64, and 128 channels. Each block consists of 3D convolutions and GELU activations without normalization layers. The output is a displacement vector with 3 components in the ( z , y , x ) (z,y,x) directions at each voxel. This allows motion to vary spatially rather than restricting the entire image to a single translation.
blocks.zh: 流量模型有3个编码相,有32个64个频道,128个频道. 每个区块由3D演化和GELU活化而无正态地层组成. 输出为相位向量,在每个相位(z,y,x)方向有3个组件. 这样可以使运动在空间上有所变化,而不是将整个图像限制在一个单一的翻译上.

blocks.en: The training objective combines self-supervised losses on real image pairs with a supervised loss on synthetic deformations. For real pairs, we use image intensity error after warping, error in the census descriptor of local contrast, forward–backward cycle consistency, spatial flow smoothness, and feature consistency under warping. Weighting by fluorescence signal and local contrast reduces the tendency toward a zero-flow solution that explains only the dominant background.
blocks.zh: 训练目标结合了真实图像配对上自我监督的损失和合成变形上的监督损失. 对于真实的对子,我们使用扭曲后图像强度错误、本地对比度的普查描述错误、前向后向周期一致性、空间流平滑性以及扭曲下特征一致性。 通过荧光信号和局部对比来进行加权,可以降低零流量解决方案的倾向,而零流量解决方案只能解释主导背景.

blocks.en: Synthetic pairs are generated by applying known translations and smooth local deformations to real images. Supervision with known displacements complements motion learning in regions where intensity consistency alone is ambiguous. The 199 training videos are shuffled with random seed 42 and split into 179 videos for flow training and 20 for validation, independently of the tracking CV folds. Real training pairs and the source images for synthetic pairs come from the 179-video subset. GT cell links are used only in the 20-video validation subset to assess endpoint error for model selection. The selected checkpoint is epoch 48, which also has the lowest validation endpoint error in the saved training history. The same flow weights are used across all CV folds and for hidden-test inference, without adaptation to hidden-test images.

blocks.en: 2.4 Cell Matching

blocks.en: Cell matching assigns correspondence scores to candidate cells in adjacent frames. Both frames, downsampled by ( 1 , 4 , 4 ) (1,4,4) , are processed by an EfficientNetV2-S 2.5D U-Net trained independently of the detector. Weights are shared between the frames, and decoder features at stride 2 relative to the input grid are sampled at detection positions using trilinear interpolation. We directly use the 64-channel intermediate decoder output, omitting the subsequent higher-resolution decoder and detection head.
blocks.zh: 单元格匹配为相邻框架中的候选单元格分配对应分数. 由(1,4,4,4)所下取样的两帧由独立于探测器的高效NetV2-S 2.5D U-Net进行处理。 重量由相框共享,相对于输入网格的阶地2的解码器特征在检测位置使用三线插值进行采样. 我们直接使用64道中间解码器输出,省略了之后的高分辨率解码器和检测头.

blocks.en: Positional encodings are added to each cell feature, and self-attention and cross-attention incorporate context within cell sets and between frames. Learnable role embeddings distinguish the preceding and following frames, encoding temporal direction. Correspondence scores use appearance cosine similarity as a prior score, with a correction derived from the attention features.
blocks.zh: 位置编码被加入到每个单元格特性中,自觉和相向结合在单元格集内和相框之间. 学习角色嵌入可以区分前帧和后帧,编码时间方向. 函授分数使用外观余弦相似度作为前作分数,从注意特征中得出校正.

blocks.en: Candidate matches are selected from motion-compensated neighborhoods. In addition to candidate scores, the matcher outputs a null score for the absence of a correspondence. Forward and backward conditional probabilities distinguish associations supported in both directions from those with strong support in only one direction. Training uses a 16 μ \mu m neighborhood, while the basic downstream candidate set contains edges among the top 5 matcher candidates whose motion-compensated distance is within 12 μ \mu m.

Cross-entropy is computed in both directions to select the correct match from a softmax over the candidates and the null option. blocks.en: A dividing parent has 2 correct daughters. We construct a separate training row for each daughter and exclude the other daughter from the negative candidates in that row. To simulate missed detections, the correct candidate is hidden with a fixed probability and the matcher is trained to select the null option. During training only, missed GT endpoints are added to ensure that positive pairs are available. No GT-based candidates are added during validation or inference.

blocks.en: The inputs consist of raw images from 3 time points and 2 aligned images. Flow compensation can reduce the effect of movement, but a single displacement cannot fully represent the one-to-two correspondence at division. Including the raw images preserves access to the original appearance and spatial arrangement.
blocks.zh: 投入包括3个时间点的原始图像和2个对齐的图像. 流动补偿可以减少流动的影响,但一次流离失所不能完全代表一对二的分出函. 包括原始图像保留了对原始外观和空间安排的访问.

blocks.en: Feature integration. Each of the five images is processed by an EfficientNetV2-S encoder with shared weights. Features from each encoder stage are concatenated along the channel dimension in the input order above and passed to a 3D decoder. The decoder uses Group Normalization, stops at stride 2, and produces a logit map through a 1 × \times 1 × \times 1 convolution. Logits are interpolated to the input grid, sampled at detection positions, and passed through a sigmoid to obtain parent scores. The flow model remains fixed, and gradients from the division loss are not propagated to it.
blocks.zh: 特色融合. 5个图像中的每个都由一台具有共享权重的高效NetV2-S编码器处理. 每个编码器阶段的地物会按照上方的输入顺序沿通道维相相接并传递到一个3D解码器上. 解码器采用Group Normalization,以Stride 2为止,并通过 1×\times 1×\times 1等分解生成一个logit映射. logits被插入输入网格,在检测位置取样,并经过一个 sigmoid以获得母分. 流出模型保持不变,从分出损失得到的梯度不向它传播.

blocks.en: Targets and training. Among detections matched to GT, parents with two children in the next frame are positive examples. Cells with ordinary continuation and daughters immediately after division are negatives. Points whose status cannot be determined, for example because an annotation ends, are excluded. The selected parent model does not include detections unmatched to GT as negatives in its loss. Missed GT parents are added to the candidates during training only.
blocks.zh: 目标和培训。 在与GT匹配的检测中,在下一个框架中有两个孩子的父母是积极的例子。 具有普通延续性的细胞和分裂后立即生出的女儿都是负数. 其地位无法确定的点,例如由于注解的结束而无法确定的点被排除在外. 被选中的母模型在其损失中不包括未与GT匹配的检测为负数. 被错过的GT家长只在培训期间加入考生.

Positive division frames account for 25% of training samples, and hard-negative frames immediately before the parent stage or just after daughter appearance account for another 25%; the remainder is sampled from ordinary frames. Common xy transformations and intensity augmentation are applied to all inputs so that augmentation itself does not create artificial temporal changes. The five-input parent model is trained for 20 epochs using AdamW, an initial learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 3 warmup epochs, and cosine decay to a minimum learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Evaluation uses an exponential moving average (EMA) with decay 0.995.

blocks.en: Auxiliary scores before and after division. In addition to the parent model, we train pre and post models independently. Positive pre examples are cells whose sole successor divides at the next time point; positive post examples are daughter cells whose parent divided immediately beforehand. Points lacking the preceding or following annotations needed to determine their status are excluded. The auxiliary models take 3 unaligned frames centered on the time being classified. For example, if a dividing parent is at time t t , the pre score of its predecessor uses images at t − 2 , t − 1 , t t-2,t-1,t .
blocks.zh: 辅助分出师前后. 除了母型外,我们还独立地训练前后型. 正面的前例是细胞,其唯一继承者在下一个时间点会分裂;正面后例是女儿细胞,其父母会立即分裂。 缺少确定其地位所需的前述或后述说明的要点不在此列。 辅助模型取取以被分类时间为中心的3个不相通相框. 例如,如果分出母在时间t t 上,其前身的预分数使用t − 2,t − 1,t 2,t 1,t .

blocks.en: Parent, pre, and post scores provide evidence about individual cells at stages surrounding division. Because the loss is normalized separately by class, the sigmoid outputs are not directly interpreted as probabilities reflecting the actual division frequency. Daughter pairs are calibrated using parent scores, daughter candidate positions, correspondence scores, and the surrounding division stages; final selection accounts for competition with ordinary links.
blocks.zh: 父母分数,前分数和后分数提供了个体细胞在分裂前后各阶段的证据. 由于损失按类别分别归正,所以 sigmoid 输出不直接被解释为反映实际分频的概率. 女儿对子采用亲子分数,女儿候选职位,函授分数,以及相邻的分相相相分相进行校正;最终选取账户为与普通链接相竞争.

blocks.en: For ordinary links and expanded division candidates, we use scores from a separate parent model with 3 unaligned image inputs. The five-input parent model combining raw and flow-aligned images is used to generate and calibrate the basic division candidates. Parent, pre, and post inference uses 4-way rotation TTA in the xy plane and fp16.
blocks.zh: 对于普通链接和扩展的分区候选者,我们使用一个单独的母模型的分数,并有3个不相通的图像输入. 五输入母模型结合了生相和相流相通的图像,用于生成并校正基本的分位候选. 家长式,前作和后作推论在xy平面和fp16中使用了4道旋转TTA.

blocks.en: 2.6 Lineage Graph Optimization
blocks.zh: 2.6 线程图优化

blocks.en: We jointly select nodes and temporal connections from the detection, matching, and division identification outputs. If ordinary connections are fixed before divisions are added, candidate daughters may already be assigned to other connections, preventing the correct division from being formed. We address this competition by including ordinary links and divisions in a common optimization problem.
blocks.zh: 我们共同从检测、匹配和分区识别产出中选择节点和时间连接。 如果在添加分数之前固定了普通的连接,则候选女儿可能已经被分配到其他连接,从而无法形成正确的分数. 我们通过将普通链接和分区纳入一个共同的优化问题来解决这一竞争。

blocks.en: Candidate event construction. Ordinary link candidates are the top 5 matcher candidates within a motion-compensated distance of 12 μ \mu m. Basic division candidates are formed from pairs of candidate edges sharing a parent. Candidate generation requires a score of at least 0.1 from the five-input parent model and checks daughter geometry and support from preceding and following correspondence candidates. We additionally use the unaligned three-input parent model and support from preceding and following links to obtain up to 5 new daughter candidates per parent within a radius of 16 μ \mu m. Pairs consisting of a representative daughter from the basic candidates and a new daughter are added as expanded division candidates. Separate calibrators are used for the basic and expanded candidates.
blocks.zh: 候选活动构建. 普通连线候选人是运动补偿距离为12 μ \ mu m 以内的前5名匹配者候选人. 基本分区候选人由一对共享父方的候选边缘组成. 候选一代需要至少从五输入母模式得到0.1分的分数,并检查女儿几何和前后的通信候选人的支持. 此外,我们使用前后链接提供的不匹配的三投母模型和支持,在16 μ\ m的半径范围内,每个父母获得最多5个新女儿候选人。 由基本候选人的一个代表女儿和一个新女儿组成的对等,作为扩大的分区候选人被增补. 基本的和被扩大的考生使用单独的计分器.

blocks.en: The parent-score threshold limits the candidates considered computationally; it is not a probability threshold for accepting a division. The optimization can revise a daughter’s connection even if the initial graph assigns it to another parent.
blocks.zh: 母分阈值对被考虑的候选人进行计算限制;这不是接受分数的概率阈值。 优化可以修改女儿的连接,即使初始图将其分配给了另一个父母。

blocks.en: Score calibration. Features include motion-compensated distance, forward and backward matcher scores, candidate ranks, margins relative to competing candidates, detection confidence, and parent, pre, and post scores. Pre scores of predecessor cells are aggregated over input candidate edges, not only over the edges ultimately selected. Examples include the maximum product of a predecessor candidate’s pre score and matcher probability, the pre score of the highest-ranked candidate, and a probability-weighted mean. This makes temporal evidence from multiple possible lineages available before the graph is selected.
blocks.zh: 分数校正. 特征包括运动补偿距离,前向和后向匹配者分数,候选人分数,相对于竞争对手的比分,检测信心,以及父母分数,前向分和后向分. 先前的分数单元格在输入候选边上相加,而不仅仅是在最终选定的边上相加。 例子包括前身候选人预分和比分概率的最大出产,排名最高的候选人预分和概率加权平均值. 这使得在选择图前可以从多个可能的行中获取时间证据.

blocks.en: Divisions are calibrated similarly. For the conditional probability of a daughter pair, the logit of a linear model with 19 features provides an initial score. LightGBM and XGBoost each learn a nonlinear residual over 100 boosting rounds. Both tree models receive the same 34 features, including daughter-to-daughter distance, distances and angular separation relative to the parent, parent and daughter appearance scores, and support from predecessor and successor candidates. These include 6 motion features, such as the discrepancy between the daughter midpoint and an extrapolation using the parent’s preceding velocity, changes in daughter velocities across time, and the predicted change in daughter separation in the next frame. The conditional probabilities from the two models are averaged with equal weights. Exposure is estimated by a separate linear model.

blocks.en: A dividing parent must have an incoming ordinary link, and each daughter must have an outgoing ordinary link. A daughter immediately after division is also prevented from dividing at the next frame boundary. This structural assumption reflects the temporal resolution of the dataset and suppresses false detections in which successive division candidates support one another. Restricting temporal support to ordinary links also excludes relaxed solutions in which fractional division variables mutually provide support. These constraints alone, however, do not guarantee a division TP under the official metric.

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The training data comprise 71 videos from embryo 44b6 and 128 videos from embryo 6bba. Training and test data come from different embryos. Each video contains 100 frames of 64 × \times 256 × \times 256 voxels. Voxel spacing is 1.625 μ \mu m along z and 0.40625 μ \mu m in the xy plane. Across all videos, annotations contain 133,318 nodes, 128,883 edges, and 151 divisions, counting annotations in overlapping crops separately. The organizer-provided estimates of total node counts sum to 4,725,117. Dividing the annotated node count by this estimate gives the approximately 2.8% ratio reported in Section 1 .
blocks.zh: 培训数据包括来自胚胎44b6的71个视频和来自胚胎6bba的128个视频。 训练和测试数据来自不同的胚胎. 每段视频包含100帧的64××分秒256×分秒256分秒. Voxel相距为1.625 μ \ mu相沿的z相距为0.40625 μ \ mu相距为xy平面相距为0.40625 μ \ mu相距为. 在所有视频中,说明包含133 318个节点、128 883个边缘和151个分块,分别计算重叠作物的说明。 组织者提供的总节点估计数为4 725 117个。 将附加说明的节点数从这一估计数中除去,得出第1节所报告的大约2.8%的比例。

blocks.en: We compare configurations using video-level 5-fold cross-validation (CV). Unless otherwise specified, scores in the main text are CV results aggregated over all 199 videos. Video IDs are sorted within each embryo and assigned to the 5 folds in round-robin order, so every fold contains videos from both embryos. All frames of a video belong to the same fold; training and validation are not split within a video.
blocks.zh: 我们使用视频5倍的交叉验证(CV)来比较配置. 除非另有说明,正文中的分数是所有199个视频的CV结果汇总. 视频 ID在每一个胚胎内部进行分类,按照圆-robin顺序被分配到5个折叠上,因此每个折叠上都包含两个胚胎的相片. 视频的所有帧都属于同一折叠;培训和验证不分入视频.

blocks.en: The detectors, matcher, and division models generate out-of-fold (OOF) predictions by excluding each video’s fold from training. For CV evaluation, each model uses one set of weights corresponding to the video’s held-out fold. Candidate features are constructed from these predictions, and calibrators are also trained without the evaluation fold. Prior rates for total cells, annotated edges, and divisions are estimated from the calibrators’ training videos. Dense flow uses the separate training and model-selection procedure described in Section 2.3 and does not follow the same 5-fold OOF scheme.
blocks.zh: 探测器、匹配器和分型模型通过将每段视频的折叠从培训中排除而产生出倍外预测。 对于CV评价,每个模型都使用与视频所持有的折叠相对应的一组权重. 候选特征是从这些预测中构建出来的,计算器也在没有评价折叠的情况下接受培训. 从计算器的训练录像中估计出所有单元格、附加说明的边缘和分区的先前费率。 深思潮使用2.3节所描述的单独培训和模式选择程序,并不遵循同样的5倍OOF计划.

blocks.en: We use stacking, with calibrators trained on OOF image-model outputs, rather than nested cross-validation that retrains all image models for each outer validation fold. Some crops from the same embryo overlap in space and time; the existing split contains 37 overlapping pairs that cross fold boundaries. Shared optimization prices are computed by pooling the expected counts from all 199 OOF predictions, with each video’s calibrators and count priors fitted outside its fold. The optimization is therefore performed jointly over the CV pool rather than separately within each evaluation fold.
blocks.zh: 我们使用堆叠, 与计算器训练 OOF 图像模型输出, 而不是嵌入式的交叉验证, 由同胚胎所生出的一些作物在空间和时间上重叠;现存的分块包含37个相重叠的对子,可以跨越折叠边界. 共享优化价格的计算方法是,将所有199个OOF预测的预期数字汇总在一起,每段视频的计算器和计数前科都安装在折叠外。 因此,优化工作是在简历库上联合进行的,而不是在每套评价中单独进行。

blocks.en: The cumulative evaluation and ablations share the detection candidates from the ensemble in Section 2.2 . The initial candidate count is 5,320,079 across all 199 videos. Section 3.4 replaces the detector to evaluate transfer of the downstream models.
blocks.zh: 累积评价和模拟在第2.2节中分享了综艺节目的检测候选人。 所有199个视频的初始候选人数为5 320 079人。 第3.4节取代了探测器来评价下游模型的转移.

blocks.en: Table 1 lists the main training settings. The 2.5D detectors use pretrained encoders, while the fully 3D detector is initialized randomly. blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: To evaluate individual components, we share detections, ordinary link and division candidates, constraints, the initial solution, and post-processing across conditions, changing only the features, probability models, or selection strategy under study. For feature ablations, the corresponding inputs are set to zero during training and inference, and the calibrators are retrained. Model outputs used for candidate generation and initialization are retained. These experiments therefore assess calibration and selection on a fixed candidate set, rather than removing an image model from the entire pipeline, including candidate generation. Section 3.3.5 retrains the division-parent models to compare input alignment on fixed candidates.
blocks.zh: 为了评价单个组件,我们共享检测,普通的链接和分区候选人,限制,初始解决方案,以及跨条件的后处理,仅改变正在研究的特征,概率模型或选择策略. 对于特征活化,在训练和推论期间,相应的输入被设定为零,而计算器被重新训练. 保留用于候选人生成和初始化的示范产出。 因此,这些实验评估了固定候选人组合的校正和选择,而不是从整个管道中去掉一个图像模型,包括候选人生成。 第3.3.5节重述司级模式,以比较固定候选人的投入一致性。

blocks.en: We estimate 95% confidence intervals (CIs) using a paired cluster bootstrap stratified by embryo, with connected components of overlapping crops as the resampling units (4,000 repetitions, random seed 67). These intervals describe resampling variability with trained models and predictions held fixed; no correction for multiple comparisons is applied.
blocks.zh: 我们估计95%的置信间隔(CIs)使用由胚胎分层而成对的集群靴子,将重叠作物的相接部分作为再生单元(4 000个重复,随机种子67)。 这些间隔说明与训练有素的模型和固定的预测进行再模拟的可变性;对多重比较没有进行校正。

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Image-Model Features Used for Calibration
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 校准所用的图像模型特征

blocks.en:
We first remove calibration features derived from flow, the matcher, and the division models separately. The flow ablation removes motion-compensated distance and its transformations. The matcher ablation removes correspondence probabilities, ranks, competitive margins, support, and motion features derived from the matcher. The division ablation removes parent, pre, and post scores and their products and aggregated features. Candidate sets, training labels and weights, priors, and the initial solution are shared, and calibrators are retrained using 5 folds.
Table 3 summarizes the results.
blocks.zh:
我们首先去除由流派,相配派,分型分别产生的校正特征. 通流衰减会去除运动补偿距离及其转化. 相配器的减速会去除从相配器中衍生出来的对应概率,分级,竞争边际,支持,以及运动等特性. 分分分分分去母分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分. 考生套装,训练标签和权重,前科,并共享初始溶液,并使用5个折叠来再训练计算器.
表3汇总了结果。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Calibration-feature ablations with fixed candidates.
blocks.zh: 表3:固定候选人的校准情况。

blocks.en: Every feature removal reduces the score both after optimization and in the final output. Removing division-model features produces the largest final-score decrease, with division Jaccard falling from 0.5266 to 0.3285 while adjusted edge Jaccard changes from 0.9235 to 0.9227. Removing flow features primarily affects the edge term, whereas removing matcher features reduces both terms.
blocks.zh: 每个特性去除都会减少优化后和最终输出中的分数. 删除分区模型特性产生最大的最终分数下降,分区雅克克从0.5266降至0.3285,而将边缘雅克克从0.9235调整为0.9227. 删除流量特性主要会影响边缘名词,而去掉匹配器特性则会减少两个名词.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Joint Selection of Ordinary Links and Divisions
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 共同选择普通链接和分部

blocks.en:
We compare joint selection with two sequential strategies under the same calibrated probabilities and objective. The first sequential strategy selects ordinary links first, then adds divisions through local replacements with positive gain, removing ordinary links that compete for the daughters. The second also allows replacement of selected divisions and alternates between local division replacement and reoptimization of ordinary links with division choices fixed. All strategies share constraints and the initial solution. The outer price update runs for at most 3 iterations, and the sequential strategy allows at most 10 alternating updates.
Table 4 summarizes the results.
blocks.zh:
我们把联合选择与两个顺序战略进行比较,这些战略都是在相同的概率和目标下进行的。 第一个相继策略首先选择了普通链接,然后通过以正增益的本地替换来添加分道扬镳,去除了为女儿们所竞争的普通链接. 第二个方案还允许在替换当地分区之间替换选定的分区和候补分区,并重新优化与既定分区选择的普通联系。 所有战略都有共同的限制和初步解决办法。 外部价格更新最多可进行3次迭代,相继战略最多可进行10次相继更新。
表4总结了结果。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Joint and sequential selection with shared candidates, calibrated values, and initialization.
blocks.zh: 表4:与共同候选人、校准值和初始化进行联合和相继选拔。

blocks.en: Joint selection improves the score by 0.0105 over the sequential strategy with alternating optimization, with positive differences in both embryos and all 5 folds. It recovers 21 additional division TPs with 3 additional FPs, reducing division FNs from 73 to 52. The adjusted edge term remains approximately unchanged, so the overall gain is primarily due to division recovery. These are official evaluation counts across crops, which can include overlapping observations of the same biological event. The alternating sequential strategy converges within at most 2 updates and does not reach the iteration limit. The two sequential strategies differ slightly in score but round to the same displayed values and interval bounds.
blocks.zh: 联合选择比相继策略提高0.0105分,并进行交替优化,胚胎和所有5个折叠都有正差. 它以3个额外的FP恢复了21个额外的分区TP,将分区新军从73个减少到52个. 调整后的边缘名词大致保持不变,因此总体收益主要出自分部恢复. 这些是跨作物的官方评价计数,可能包括对同一生物事件的重叠观测。 交替相继策略在最多2个更新中会汇合而未达到迭接极限. 两项相继策略在分数上略有不同,但回合与相同显示的值和间隔界限相差不大。

blocks.en:
Analysis at the shared first-round prices shows that, among 15 positive basic division candidates selected only by the joint strategy, 13 lack an incoming ordinary link to the parent or an outgoing ordinary link from a daughter in the sequential solution. This suggests the value of selecting a division together with the ordinary links supporting it before and after the event, relative to the sequential strategies evaluated here. This analysis uses candidate labels and is distinct from the difference in division TP under the official metric.
Figure 2 illustrates a division selected together with its supporting links.
blocks.zh:
对共享第一回合价格的分析表明,在只有联合战略选定的15名积极的基本分区候选人中,有13名在顺序解决方案中缺乏与父母的普通联系或女儿的普通联系。 这表明,相对于本文所评价的相继战略而言,选择一个分区以及活动前后支持它的一般链接的价值。 本分析使用候选标签,并区别于官方度量法下分TP的不同.
图2显示选定的司及其辅助链接。

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Exposure, Calibrators, and the Objective
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 接触、校准和目标

blocks.en: To assess the probability of being evaluated, we hold Conditional fixed and replace Exposure with event-type-specific constants estimated from training videos outside the evaluation fold. We compare three conditions: constant Exposure for ordinary links only, for divisions only, and for both. This preserves the decomposition into TP, FP, and unevaluated probabilities while testing the benefit of learning candidate-specific Exposure.
blocks.zh: 为了评估被评价的概率,我们定有条件,用评价外的训练录像中估计的特定事件类型的常数取而代之。 我们比较了三个条件:只有普通链接、只有分部和两个部分经常暴露。 这保留了分解为TP,FP和未经评价的概率,同时测试学习候选人特定接触的好处.

blocks.en: For division Conditional, we compare a linear model, a model that adds a LightGBM residual to a linear logit, and an ensemble of LightGBM and XGBoost probabilities, using the same 34 features and targets. Missing features in the linear model are imputed with training-fold medians. The tree models use the 19-feature linear model from Section 2.6 for their initial logits, whereas the standalone linear comparator receives 34 features. Exposure and ordinary link calibration remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 对于划分条件,我们比较一个线性模型,一个在线性对数中添加了LightGBM残基的模型,以及一个由LightGBM和XGBooost概率组成的组合,使用相同的34个特性和目标. 线性模型中缺失的特征由训练-倍中位数来估算. 树型采用第2.6节的19个地貌线性模型进行初始对数,而独立的线性参照物则获得34个地貌. 接触和普通链接校正仍然固定不变。

blocks.en:
For the objective, we compare the control against setting the node price in the linearized problem to 0 and against stopping after one solve using prices computed from the initial solution. Setting the node price to 0 retains the node-count adjustment on edges and the surrogate-based decision to accept a new solution.
Table 5 summarizes the results.
blocks.zh:
为了实现这个目标,我们将控制与线性化问题中的节点价格设定比作0,并用从最初解决方案计算出的价格解决后停止控制。 将节点价格设定为0,保留了边缘的节点计价调整和以替代人为基础的接受新解决方案的决定.
表5汇总了结果。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Ablations of Exposure, calibrators, and the objective.
blocks.zh: 表5:接触量、发热器和目标。

blocks.en: The upper bound displayed as +0.0000 is positive before rounding.
blocks.zh: 上行显示为+0.0000,四舍五入前为正.

blocks.en: The calibration ensemble outperforms the 34-feature linear model by 0.0042. The individual benefits of adding a tree model and ensembling could not be established. The ensemble-minus-linear differences are − - 0.0009 for embryo 44b6 and +0.0055 for embryo 6bba, showing that the improvement differs between embryos.
blocks.zh: 校正综艺优于34地平线型以0.042. 增加一棵树模式和全息合作的个人好处无法确定。 共聚-减-线性差异为−-0.0009胚胎44b6和+0.00555胚胎6bba,表明胚胎的改善不同.

blocks.en: Replacing ordinary link Exposure with a constant changes the score immediately after optimization by − - 0.0027. Setting the node price to 0 changes the score by − - 0.0011 after optimization, with the difference shrinking to approximately 0 after post-processing and reaching +0.0001 in the final output. Allowing up to 3 price-update rounds, with a new solution accepted only if the surrogate improves, gives a point estimate 0.0021 higher than stopping after one round. The final-output comparisons do not establish clear improvements from learned Exposure, the explicit node price, or repeated price updates.
blocks.zh: 以常数取代普通链接曝光在优化后立即以--0.027. 将节点价格设定为0在优化后将分数更改为−-0.0011,而差额在后处理后缩小为约0. 0. 允许最多3个价格更新回合,新解决方案只有在被替代者改善的情况下才被接受,给出了比一回合后停止高0.0021分的估计. 最终产出比较没有从学到的曝光、明确的节点价格或反复更新价格中确定明确的改进。

blocks.en: 3.3.4 Auxiliary Information Before and After Division
blocks.zh: 3.3.4 分部前后的辅助信息

blocks.en:
We perform a 2 × \times 2 comparison of pre and post features while retaining parent scores. The corresponding features are removed from both ordinary links and divisions, and calibrators are retrained. Removing pre also removes aggregated features derived from predecessor candidates’ pre scores.
Table 6 summarizes the results.
blocks.zh:
我们在保留家长分数的同时,对前作和后作2个比较。 相应的功能被从普通链接和分解中去除,并重新训练出计算器. 删除预览也会去除前身候选人预考分数产生的汇总特征.
表6汇总了结果。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Auxiliary information before and after division.
blocks.zh: 表6:分部前后辅助信息.

blocks.en: Averaged over the presence or absence of the other auxiliary feature group, the effects on the final score [95% CI] are +0.0013 [ − - 0.0007, +0.0034] for pre and +0.0073 [+0.0034, +0.0113] for post. The interaction is − - 0.0013 [ − - 0.0055, +0.0025]. This comparison supports an average benefit from post, while the effects of pre and the interaction remain unclear.
blocks.zh: 平均于其他辅助特征组是否存在,对最终分数[95% CI]的影响为:前为+0.0013 [−-0.0007,+0.0034],后为+0.0073 [+0.0034,+0.0113]. 相互作用为--0.0013 [--0.0055,+0.0025]. 这种比较有助于员额的平均效益,而事前和互动的影响仍不清楚。

blocks.en: 3.3.5 Flow Alignment with a Matched Number of Inputs
blocks.zh: 3.3.5 与投入相匹配的流量对齐

blocks.en: We compare the presence and absence of alignment while holding the division-parent model’s input count, temporal window, and capacity fixed. The control uses raw and flow-aligned images. The ablation replaces each aligned image with a duplicate of the corresponding raw image, yielding [ I t − 1 , I t − 1 , I t , I t + 1 , I t + 1 ] [I_{t-1},I_{t-1},I_{t},I_{t+1},I_{t+1}] . Both conditions use 3 time points, 5 inputs, and 39,382,145 parameters. Training settings and the number of training examples presented per epoch are matched, and each fold is trained for 20 epochs.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了存在和缺乏对齐,同时将师级模型的输入计数、时间窗口和容量固定下来。 控件使用原始和流相相映像. 将每个对齐的图像取而代之的是相应的原始图像,产生[一t- 1,一t- 1,一t- 1,一t+ 1,一t+ 1] [一-t-1},一-t-1},一-t},一-t},一-t},一-t+1},一-t+1}]。 这两个条件都使用3个时间点,5个投入,以及39,382,145个参数. 培训设置和每个时代提供的培训实例数目相匹配,每套培训20个时代。

blocks.en:
Both conditions are trained using the OOF outputs of the 3-detector ensemble in Section 2.2 . Parent scores for basic division candidates are replaced with each model’s predictions, and Conditional and Exposure are recalibrated. The candidate set, parent scores used to generate it, parent features for expanded candidates, ordinary links, pre and post scores, and the initial solution are held fixed. The comparison concerns the difference between two models trained under matched conditions.
Table 7 summarizes the results.
blocks.zh:
这两种条件都利用第2.2节的3名探测员的OOF产出进行训练。 基本师生的家长分数被每个模型的预测所取代,有条件的和接触的则重新调整. 考生集,用来生成的家长分数,扩展考生的家长特征,普通链接,职前和职后分数,以及初始解决方案被固定. 比较涉及在相应条件下培训的两个模式之间的差异。
表7汇总了结果。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Input alignment with matched model capacity and training settings.
blocks.zh: 表7:与匹配的模式能力和培训环境相匹配的投入。

blocks.en: Both rows use newly trained division-parent models; the aligned control is therefore distinct from the main pipeline model used in Sections 3.2 – 3.3.4 .
blocks.zh: 两行均使用新训练的分母型号;因此对接控制不同于3.2–3.3.4节中使用的主要管线型号.

blocks.en:
Alignment changes the score by +0.0022 after optimization and by +0.0023 in the final output (95% CI [ − - 0.0005, +0.0052]). In the final output, division FP decreases from 41 to 34, while adjusted edge Jaccard decreases slightly from 0.9235 to 0.9234. Although the point estimate of the overall score increases, the comparison does not establish a clear benefit from alignment.
Figure 3 shows two candidate-level examples.
blocks.zh:
对齐在优化后将分数变化为+0.0022,在最终输出后将分数变化为+0.0023(95% CI [−-0.0005,+0.0052]). 在最后产出中,司FP从41个减为34个,而调整后的边缘Jaccard则从0.9235略为减少为0.9234个. 虽然总体分数的分数估计值会增加,但比较并未确定对等的明显好处.
图3显示两个候选级别的例子。

Maximum-intensity projections use the same local z range after 3D alignment and a shared intensity range within each row. Crosses mark the parent candidate’s location in the central frame. blocks.en: 3.4 Replacement with a Public Detector and Calibration Transfer

blocks.en: To evaluate transfer of the downstream models after changing the detector, we replace the detection stage with that from Pilkwang Kim’s public notebook, Biohub Cell Tracking: Two Seeds Logit Blend [ 7 ] . This detector uses TemporalUNet3D to integrate temporal features from consecutive images. We use the notebook’s publicly available primary-model and second-seed weights, rescale the second model’s logits using the primary model’s mean and standard deviation, and combine them by a weighted average with weight 0.475. Each model uses 8-way TTA, and the combined detection threshold is 0.96875. We compare direct transfer of the downstream models, retraining only the calibrators, and retraining the matcher, division models, and calibrators. Flow is shared across conditions.

blocks.en: 3.5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3.5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Interpretation of the results. On fixed candidates, improvements are observed from joint selection of ordinary links and divisions, the calibration ensemble relative to a linear model, and auxiliary information after division. The final-output comparisons do not establish clear improvements from learned Exposure, an explicit node price, repeated price updates, auxiliary information before division, or flow-based input alignment.
blocks.zh: 解说出结果. 关于固定候选人,从共同选择普通链接和分区、与线性模型相对的校正组合和分区后的辅助信息中观察到改进。 最终产出比较没有从所学的曝光、明确的节点价格、重复更新的价格、划分前的辅助信息或以流量为基础的输入对接中确定明确的改进。

blocks.en: Detection and downstream tracking. Cell detections are the shared input to correspondence estimation and division identification. Downstream classification alone cannot recover divisions with missing daughter detections or daughters outside the candidate search range. We evaluate the complete pipeline using the 2.5D and 3D detector ensemble trained for sparse annotations as a common foundation, and compare downstream components on fixed candidates. We do not individually ablate the detection mask, loss normalization, or ensemble members.
blocks.zh: 检测和下游跟踪。 细胞检测是对函证估计和分部识别的共同输入. 仅靠下游分类无法恢复在候选搜索范围以外发现失踪女儿或女儿的分裂. 我们利用2.5D和3D探测器组合来评估整个输油管,这些探测器是作为稀有说明而训练的,作为共同的基础,并比较固定候选人的下游部件。 我们并不个别地降低检测口罩、损失正常化或共同成员。

blocks.en: Scope. Because the official metric relies on annotated lineages, it does not comprehensively evaluate tracking accuracy in unannotated regions. Remaining challenges include the approximate inverse displacement used to align preceding frames, interpolation across long gaps, and the difference between division calibration targets and the temporal tolerance of the official evaluation.
blocks.zh: 范围。 由于官方衡量标准依赖于附加说明的分行,因此没有全面评估无附加说明区域的跟踪准确性. 其余的挑战包括:用于调整前述框架的近似反向流离失所、跨越长期差距的内插以及划分校正目标与官方评价时间容忍度之间的差异。

blocks.en: Computational design. To reduce inference computation, the matcher computes only the intermediate features needed for correspondence estimation, and dense flow is shared between matching and division input alignment. Auxiliary division models using unaligned images can reuse encoder features across overlapping temporal windows.
blocks.zh: 计算设计. 为了减少推论计算,匹配者只计算函证估计所需的中间特性,密通流由匹配和分出输入对接共享. 使用不相通图像的辅助分型模型可以重复使用跨重叠时间窗口的编码特性.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We presented a 3D cell tracking method that integrates detection from sparse annotations, calibration using motion, appearance, and division features, and joint selection of ordinary links and divisions. The 2.5D and 3D models are trained with suppressed background supervision at unannotated cells, and their outputs are combined into a common set of detection candidates for downstream processing. Candidate connections are calibrated using features from dense flow, the matcher, and models that identify cells immediately before division, dividing parents, and daughters immediately after division. Ordinary links and divisions are selected jointly under lineage constraints. Gap filling and coordinate refinement based on temporal consistency further improve tracking performance.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个3D细胞跟踪方法,将从稀有的注释中检测到,利用运动,外观,和分化特征进行校正,以及共同选择普通链接和分化. 2.5D型和3D型在无附加说明的细胞中接受被压制后的背景监督培训,其输出被组合成一套用于下游加工的常见检测候选. 考生的连接通过来自密集流的特征,配对者,以及那些在分裂前立即识别出细胞,在分裂后立即分裂出父母和女儿的模型来校正. 普通的链接和分区是在世系限制下联合选择的. 根据时间一致性填补和协调完善差距,进一步改善了跟踪业绩。

blocks.en: The pipeline achieves an overall score of 0.9762 in 5-fold CV on all 199 videos. With candidates and calibrated values held fixed, joint selection outperforms a sequential method that alternates ordinary link and division optimization by 0.0105. Improvements are also observed for the calibration ensemble relative to a linear model and for the average effect of auxiliary information after division. These results support integrating motion, appearance, and division assessment of detection candidates with selection of connections across the lineage graph.
blocks.zh: 管道在所有199个视频中以5倍CV的总分达到0.9762分. 由于候选人和定值的校正,联合选择的成绩超过了按顺序排列的方法,在0.0105之前将普通链接和分区优化。 相对于线性模型的校正同构和分出后辅助信息的平均效果也有了改进. 这些结果支持将检测对象的运动、外观和分层评估与跨家族图的联系进行整合。
